component.name: Phidler
component.summary: Visual CAD for photonic integrated circuit layout

description.p: Phidler is a graphical CAD application for photonic integrated circuit layout, built on gdsfactory. Place and route components, export GDS, and run FDTD simulations of your layout with the bundled photonfdtd solver.

Remote simulation works from the Flatpak: its ssh no longer rejects a group-writable SSH config, and setup installs the matching release on the remote instead of trying to upload the app. The remote gets a backend-only install without Qt. A dropped connection is retried rather than triggering a reinstall, and NVIDIA drivers reporting CUDA 13 get JAX's CUDA 13 build. The Tidy3D engine is removed.

Typed X, Y and rotation in the Properties panel now move the component when applied, and Enter applies them. Routes can be clicked from a few pixels away, and Duplicate, Copy and Paste bring the routes between the selected parts along. Arrays can be spaced by the gap between copies as well as by pitch. Opening a project that uses a component this install can't build now says which one and why, and leaves the open layout as it was.

A 1 x 2 lithium niobate Mach-Zehnder switch: one input through a Y-junction splitter, split 50:50 at 0 V and switched fully to either output at plus or minus half V-pi. The FDTD window's propagation controls now scroll instead of being squeezed in a small window.

A lithium niobate Mach-Zehnder switch that starts with a 50:50 beamsplitter, its couplers sized for a 50:50 split at whatever width it is drawn at. One project-wide waveguide width, set by hand or from the suggested single-mode width, that every route and component follows unless its own parameters say otherwise. Probe graphs of intensity, field, energy or spectrum, in dB, shared or overlaid.
Drag a corner to resize a shape, and edit a rectangle's size or an ellipse's radii in the Properties panel.
Remote runs: pick the server from the hosts in your ssh config. Each host keeps its own acceleration and install settings.
The Circuit tab waits for an interrupted build before starting another, and a component file that changes while Phidler asks whether to trust it is refused.

Adds a Circuit tab that simulates the whole chip as a circuit of physics-based models (operating point, voltage and wavelength sweeps, time domain), a lithium niobate palette of voltage-controlled switches, and component files: parts with layout, pins and model in one file, imported, kept in library folders and exported from a selection. Needs photonfdtd 0.16.

Runs FDTD on photonfdtd 0.15's JAX engine, on the GPU when JAX sees one, adds a Train tab that fits a region of the layout to a task like a neural network (with a built-in binary priority encoder), and a JAX GPU check.
